prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: salin-penkki-v2, one photographic source image for reconstruction as a robust solid 3D bench.
Generate exactly ONE entirely NEW whole PNG image, using the attached v1 bench ONLY as a reference for silhouette, proportions, dark reddish-brown zitan/hongmu wood, straight seat and legs, and Chinese decorative vocabulary. This is a new complete photograph, not a partial edit. The critical change is that every decorative apron and side panel is now a SOLID CONTINUOUS WOOD BOARD WITH SHALLOW RELIEF CARVING. Eliminate ALL pierced lattice and openwork from the panels.
Bench: one long low Qing-inspired wooden bench, intended width1.60m × depth0.45m × height0.50m. Flat straight rectangular wooden seat, no backrest, no arms, no cushion. Four straight square-section legs, one at each corner, structurally connected to the seat/frame. Thin restrained straight seat-edge molding. The long front apron, long rear apron and both end-side panels are thick, unbroken dark reddish-brown wooden boards. All visible decorative panels are fully backed by opaque wood across their entire surface. Use shallow simple Chinese rectangular scroll motifs and a small central stylized flower carved IN LOW RELIEF ON THE SOLID SURFACE. The panel wood is clearly visible behind and between every decorative line. Relief is modest, broad and smoothly attached to its backing, not spidery thin tendrils. No holes, perforations, piercing, freestanding lattice, gaps inside panels, translucent grid, detached hanging fragments, floating decorations or tear-like voids. Under the bottom edge of the apron there may be the ordinary open space between the four legs; it is only the panels themselves that must be completely solid. It is NOT a box chest: retain clear short feet below the apron and the original low bench silhouette.
Surface: natural fine irregular wood grain, dark warm red-brown satin hardwood, subtle realistic wear, same overall material color as the reference. No synthetic squiggly surface texture, no gold, no painted ornaments, no metallic wood and no mirror-like polish. All ornament is shallow relief in the SAME opaque wood, not cut through it.
Framing: entire single bench comfortably inside a landscape3:2 frame, three-quarter view showing the long front solid panel, near end solid panel, top, and straight feet. No cropping. Natural modest lens perspective. All four legs belong to the object with no extra legs or supports.
Backdrop and lighting: neutral mid-gray background all around the object, no visible floor, ground plane, horizon, room, other objects, text, labels, measurements, logo or watermark. Even diffuse neutral photographic lighting from all sides, no environmental cast shadows. Just enough gentle self-shading to read shallow relief; do not imitate the dark holes in the reference image. Real photographed furniture, not illustration or a stylized 3D render. Most important: SOLID UNPERFORATED CARVED WOOD PANELS, no openwork anywhere.
